person.occupation: Land owner and member of the armed forces

note.p: Archdale Wilson Tayler (1759-1814) and his wife Frances Elizabeth née Hall (1766/7-1845). A W Tayler was a country landowner until forced to go into the army, having been ruined by his agentThe couple had seventeen children. (john Frederick Taylor (1802-1889)was a watercolourist and etcher. A younger brother, William Tayler, became commissioner of Patna in India, and an uncle, Charles Henry Hall, was dean of Christ Church, Oxford.

That there were so many children makes the difficulty of identifying particular individuals challenging. It looks like Godwin first meets a Tayler in the form of T. Tayloer in 1811 and there is then a spate of contact with the father and a C Taylor, a Fra Taylor and a Miss Taylor. They all appear in a rather short window. We have given all these the same code as the father.
